meta.project: SubKo — Creator Promotion & Video Feedback Rewards

product_overview: SubKo is a rewards marketplace where users earn BUG's by completing verified video tasks and spend BUG's to promote their own content. The app also includes referral sharing, wallet top-ups, profile management, and an admin workspace for moderation and operations.
core_goals: Create an account and access the app
Log in to an existing account and recover access when needed
Discover and complete rewarded video tasks to earn BUG's
View balance, transaction history, and submit manual UPI top-ups
Spend BUG's to request content promotions
Manage profile settings and submission history
Allow admins to review, moderate, and manage users, tasks, promotions, and payments

features.name: Welcome Navigation
features.description: Users can start from the landing screen and move into sign up or login from there.
user_flows: Navigate to Welcome -> View the landing screen -> Choose to get started -> See the sign up screen
Navigate to Welcome -> View the landing screen -> Choose to log in -> See the login screen

features.name: User Login
features.description: Existing users can sign in with email and password to reach the authenticated area.
user_flows: Navigate to Login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit sign in form -> See the authenticated home experience
Navigate to Login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit sign in form -> Enter invalid credentials -> See login error message
Navigate to Login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit sign in form -> See server offline alert
Navigate to Login -> Choose forgot password -> See the password reset request screen

features.name: User Signup
features.description: New users can create an account with a username, email, password, and optional referral code.
user_flows: Navigate to SignUp -> Enter username -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Optionally enter referral code -> Submit account creation form -> See account creation confirmation

features.name: Forgot Password
features.description: Users can request a password reset link for their account email.
user_flows: Navigate to ForgotPassword -> Enter email -> Submit reset request -> See confirmation that an email was sent -> Return to login

features.name: Reset Password
features.description: Users who arrive through the recovery session can set a new password.
user_flows: Navigate to ResetPassword -> Enter new password -> Enter confirm password -> Submit password update -> See the updated password confirmed
Navigate to ResetPassword -> Enter new password -> Enter confirm password -> Submit password update -> Enter mismatched or too-short passwords -> See validation error

features.name: Home Task Feed
features.description: Signed-in users can browse recent tasks, refresh the feed, and open a task to begin earning.
user_flows: Navigate to Home -> View balance and task feed -> Tap a standard task card -> Open the task execution screen
Navigate to Home -> View balance and VIP banner -> Tap the VIP banner -> Open the task execution screen
Navigate to Home -> Pull to refresh -> See the task list update

features.name: Task Execution & Submission
features.description: Users complete a video task, provide proof, answer a question, and submit for review and points.
user_flows: Navigate to TaskScreen -> Start the task session -> Watch the video or open the reel -> Wait for the timer to complete -> Continue to proof submission
Navigate to TaskScreen -> Start the task session -> Watch the video or open the reel -> Provide a screenshot proof -> Select an MCQ answer -> Submit the task -> See successful submission
Navigate to TaskScreen -> Start the task session -> Attempt to submit without proof or without answering the MCQ -> See validation error

features.name: Wallet & UPI Top-up
features.description: Users can inspect their balance and transaction history and submit a manual UPI payment top-up.
user_flows: Navigate to Wallet -> View current balance and transactions -> Pull to refresh -> See updated wallet activity
Navigate to Wallet -> Enter top-up amount -> Enter UTR or transaction ID -> Add payment screenshot -> Confirm submission -> See the payment marked pending
Navigate to Wallet -> Enter top-up amount below the minimum -> Attempt to submit -> See validation error

features.name: Promotion Request
features.description: Users can spend BUG's to promote a video by selecting platform and tier, entering links, creating an MCQ, and confirming the request.
user_flows: Navigate to Promote -> Select a platform -> Select a promotion tier -> Enter channel link and video link -> Create the MCQ question and options -> Mark the correct answer -> Confirm the promotion request -> See the request submitted
Navigate to Promote -> Select a platform -> Select a promotion tier -> Enter details -> Confirm the promotion request -> Enter invalid data or insufficient balance -> See validation error

features.name: Referral
features.description: Users can view their referral code, copy it, and review referral performance stats.
user_flows: Navigate to Refer -> View referral code and referral link -> Copy the referral code -> See the code copied
Navigate to Refer -> View referral statistics -> Pull to refresh -> See updated referral stats

features.name: Profile & Settings
features.description: Users can update profile details, manage basic preferences, copy referral info, and log out.
user_flows: Navigate to Profile -> Open settings -> Edit username -> Save changes -> See the updated profile name
Navigate to Profile -> Tap the avatar -> Choose a new profile image -> Upload the image -> See the updated avatar
Navigate to Profile -> Toggle push notifications -> See the preference change take effect
Navigate to Profile -> Copy referral code -> See the code copied
Navigate to Profile -> Log out -> Return to the unauthenticated state

features.name: My Proofs History
features.description: Users can review their submitted proofs and promoted tasks, inspect proof images, and report a user from a proof entry.
user_flows: Navigate to MyProofs -> View the list of submitted proofs and promoted tasks -> Open a proof thumbnail -> See the proof image full screen
Navigate to MyProofs -> View a proof entry -> Report the user -> See the report action submitted

features.name: Banned Lock Screen
features.description: Banned users are shown a locked screen with limited actions.
user_flows: See Banned screen -> View the locked account message -> Log out -> Return to the unauthenticated state
See Banned screen -> View the locked account message -> Choose contact support -> Open the support link

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Admins can switch into a dedicated workspace to review analytics, manage users, moderate submissions, handle payments, and use tools.
user_flows: Navigate to Profile -> Switch to admin panel -> See the admin dashboard tabs
Navigate to AdminTabs -> View analytics metrics -> Export data -> See the exported report available
Navigate to AdminTabs -> Search for a user -> Ban or unban the user -> See the user status update
Navigate to AdminTabs -> Search for a user -> Credit BUG's to the user -> See the balance update
Navigate to AdminTabs -> Review pending submissions or promotions -> Approve or reject an item -> See the moderation result recorded
Navigate to AdminTabs -> Review pending payments -> Approve or reject the payment -> See the payment status update
Navigate to AdminTabs -> Create a task -> Toggle the task state or delete it -> See the task list update
Navigate to AdminTabs -> Open system logs -> View recent operational activity

tech_stack: Express backend (single-origin, served from same domain on port 5000)

routes.description: Landing/marketing screen with Get Started and Login buttons
Email + password login. Admin emails hit backend login; regular users use Supabase Auth.
Username, email, password, optional referral code signup via Supabase
Send password reset link via Supabase resetPasswordForEmail
Reached via Supabase PASSWORD_RECOVERY recovery session; set new password
Task feed with VIP banner carousel and standard task cards
Task execution: watch timer (YouTube) or reel (Instagram), screenshot proof, MCQ, submit
Balance, transactions, UPI manual top-up with UTR + payment screenshot
3-step promotion spend wizard (platform, tier, links, MCQ, confirm)
Referral code display, copy, share, and referral stats
Settings, edit username, avatar, logout, admin panel switch
User's submitted proofs and promoted tasks history
Payment proof submission (UTR + screenshot) for UPI top-up

Fill admin password field

features.name: User Signup

Fill email input field
Fill password input field (with show/hide eye toggle)

features.name: Home Task Feed

Pull to refresh the task list

Pick a screenshot proof image
Select an MCQ answer option

Pull to refresh transactions

See pending payments status

Select tier (Standard 49 / VIP 200 BUG's)
Fill channel link and video link
Create MCQ question with 4 options and mark the correct one
Click "Confirm" to spend points and submit the promotion

features.name: Referral
features.description: View personal referral code and stats, copy the code, and share.
user_interactions: View referral code and referral link
Click copy button to copy referral code
View referral stats (total/rewarded/earnings)
Pull to refresh stats

Open settings modal and edit username

known_limitations.issue: App is a single-page React Native web build with client-side navigation (screen-name routing), not URL-based routes; deep-linking by URL path is not supported.
known_limitations.impact: Each "route" in this summary maps to a logical screen, not a distinct URL path.

known_limitations.issue: Regular user login/signup depend on Supabase Auth succeeding; only admin login authenticates purely against the backend.
known_limitations.impact: End-to-end user login tests require valid Supabase Auth credentials or email confirmation.

known_limitations.issue: CASHFREE_ENABLED is false; only manual UPI top-up with UTR + screenshot is available.
known_limitations.impact: Online gateway payment path cannot be tested; only the manual UPI flow is reachable.
